question.text: Which pair of ions among the following can be separated by precipitation method?

solution.text:
$\mathrm{A} \rightarrow \mathrm{Eu}^{+2}$ and $\mathrm{yb}^{2+}$ have unique property \& show similarity with $\mathrm{Sr}^{+2}$. Hence $\mathrm{EuSO}_4$ is insoluble like $\mathrm{SrSO}_4$ & other lanthanide ions remains unaffected in solution.
$\mathrm{D} \rightarrow$ fact
